title: NEMA Starters

## Single Phase Motors

Maximum horsepower with full voltage starting and two pole contactors:

| NEMA Size | 115V | 230V |
|-----------|------|------|
| 00 | 1/3 | 1 |
| 0 | 1 | 2 |
| 1 | 2 | 3 |
| 2 | 3 | 7.5 |
| 3 | 7.5 | 15 |
